subject: Ownership & procurement next steps for Solstice pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Liao <kate@solsticeai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Ownership & procurement next steps for Solstice pilot

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap + immediate asks so we can keep momentum: 

Summary (what we covered)
- Technical fit: Redwood can meet your latency and SSO requirements for the 30k-token eval use case we reviewed.
- Scope: 2-week pilot using the 7b-quantized model, integration via standard REST SDK and optional streaming.
- Success criteria we agreed: throughput >= 30 reqs/sec, average generation latency < 350ms, and stable cost per token within the pilot baseline.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Please introduce the person who owns the budget for this pilot (we understand procurement handles contracting but need the economic buyer to sign off).
2) Can you share the right security contact for the SOC2 / data handling Q&A? (name + email).
3) Procurement: can you confirm Solstice’s preferred contracting flow (PO + addendum vs. DocuSign SOW)?
4) Proposed next meeting: 30‑minute align call including budget owner + security – I’m available Tue/Wed next week 10–12 PT.

We’ve attached a one‑pager with the proposed pilot scope and a cost worksheet so you have concrete numbers.

If you can loop in the CFO or whoever signs POs, that’ll help us map an expedited procurement path and avoid surprises on discounts/credits.

Thanks — looking forward to the intro.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood-trial-scope.pdf (1 page), pilot-cost-worksheet.xlsx (est. cost breakout)

Subject: Re: Ownership & procurement next steps for Solstice pilot

Thanks Ben — good recap. A few quick answers below: 

- Budget owner: final sign-off comes from our CFO, Elena Morales (elena@solsticeai.com). She typically delegates evaluation to the head of ML but will need the numbers and an intro before procurement moves forward.
- Security contact: James Whitman (james.whitman@solsticeai.com), who owns vendor security reviews.
- Procurement flow: we prefer PO + our standard SaaS addendum; legal will want to review any SLA or data residency clauses. I’ve cc’d procurement general inbox for visibility (procurement@solsticeai.com).

Elena is out of office until Thursday but I can send a short one‑line intro to her and copy you if that helps. Can we do Wed 11am PT for the alignment call (Elena may join briefly)?

On discounts — we don’t make commitments in the discovery thread, but I’ll surface expected spend bands to Elena.

On Wed meeting, can you include a short agenda and a one-slide cost/ROI? That’ll make it easy for Elena to absorb quickly.

Best,
Kate

Questions for you both: 
- Monica: can we commit to a pilot credit/discount to accelerate the POC? Kate warned we can’t promise, but CEO/cfo prefer concrete numbers. What flexibility do we have for SOL-842? I would propose a 15% pilot credit off list, but I can accept 10% if legal needs quicker turnaround. Please advise and confirm any required approval chain.
- Sean: procurement will want a security checklist and answers for SOC2 scope, SSO, and data retention. Can your team confirm we can produce a short security Q&A and an admin-only audit log extract? If you want, I can introduce James to our security reviewer.

—
Ben
